home.tagline: The platform for archers and their coaches.

register.title: Create an account
register.rolesRequired: Choose at least one profile: archer or coach.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.
checkEmail.notReceived: Nothing received? Check your spam folder, or:
checkEmail.resent: If a pending account exists for this address, a new link has just been sent.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Click the button to activate your account.
verifyEmail.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Please use the link from the email.

onboarding.title: Welcome!
onboarding.body: One last step: tell us who you are.

errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired, please sign in again.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong, please try again.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account already exists with this email address.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your email address isn't confirmed yet. Please check your inbox.
errors.INVALID_VERIFICATION_TOKEN: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
errors.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Your session has expired, please sign in again.
errors.INVALID_ID_TOKEN: Signing in with this provider failed.
errors.SESSION_OUTSIDE_JOURNAL: The session date is outside the journal's period.
errors.JOURNAL_PERIOD_EXCLUDES_SESSIONS: Some sessions of this journal fall outside the new period. Widen it, or move or delete those sessions.
errors.INVALID_INVITATION_TOKEN: This invitation is invalid or has been withdrawn.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the maximum number of items. Delete one to continue.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: This file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This photo is larger than 10 MB.
errors.MONTH_HAS_NO_THEME: Choose a decoration for this month first.

validation.isUrl: Invalid address (it must start with https://).

archer.homeIntro: Your archer area: sessions, sheets and progress in one place.
archer.journalIntro: Your training sessions and competitions: date, distance, arrow count, scores, feelings.
archer.sheetsIntro: Your technique sheets and memos: technique points, instructions, personal notes.
archer.statsIntro: Your progress in numbers: arrow volume, scores, consistency.
archer.profileIntro: Your licence, category, bow and disciplines, your invited people and your favourite websites.

journal.newSessionHint: Pick the type, date and time: the details to fill in come next.
journal.timeHint: Optional: without a time, the event lasts all day.
journal.deleteBody: The event and its sheet will be permanently deleted.
journal.strengthComing: The strength training form is coming soon. You can already put the session in your calendar.
journal.title: Title
journal.titleHint: Shown in the calendar, with the colour and the pictogram.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB at most per photo. Photos are resized and stay private.
photos.deleteBody: The photo will be permanently deleted.

journals.empty: No journal yet. Create one per season, for example “Season 2026-2027”.
journals.newHint: A journal covers one season: all your sessions of the period are grouped in it.
journals.title: Title
journals.sessions: {count, plural, =0 {No sessions} one {# session} other {# sessions}}
journals.deleteBody: The journal “{title}” will be permanently deleted.
journals.deleteSessions: {count, plural, one {Its session will be deleted with it.} other {Its # sessions will be deleted with it.}}
journals.noneBody: Your sessions are kept in one journal per season. Create one to get started.
journals.editHint: The period must keep covering the sessions already recorded in this journal.
journals.monthThemeHint: Each month of the journal can have its own decoration around the calendar.

coloring.hint: Pick a colour, then click an area of the decoration to fill it.

guests.addHint: The person receives an invitation email. For now, accepting gives them no access to your data.
guests.name: Name
